strings.updates.6a3a96a0: The Display panel got a cleaner look: small cards for Text size, Screen and Language, amber switches, and Reset and Done at the bottom.
strings.updates.6fa9f2f3: Every lake now opens with Tonight at a glance: lake level, water temp, sunset and tonight’s wind, each linked to its USGS, Army Corps or National Weather Service source. Lakes with no public gauge say so.
strings.updates.6fee4328: Nothing new to see on the water pages this time. I set up a full check that opens every page on a phone, tablet and desktop size and flags broken links, missing titles or images without descriptions before anything goes live.
strings.updates.750a8c30: Dock season adds dated notes for Hoover, Griggs, O’Shaughnessy, Delaware and Indian Lake, and Water notes Seneca’s 5 ft winter drawdown starting Nov. 15.

strings.updates.dacaea4e: Tap Sort by my location on the card to sort shops from where you are standing. Your location stays on your device, and without it the list stays sorted from the lake.

strings.updates.df4922fc: After an update, a page reloads only when it is out of date.
strings.updates.e5fd7a08: Species pages get clearer titles and descriptions: yellow perch no longer says 3 lakes, and blue catfish now lists Alum Creek, where ODNR stocked them from 2023 to 2025.
strings.updates.ea2751ae: Remind me sets a reminder for any time of day, from a time wheel or the Sunset button, in your calendar or on your phone.
strings.updates.eae45fc3: The new lake picker lets you search by name, star the lakes you fish so they stay up top in Your lakes, and use Near me to see the closest water. Near me works out the distance on your phone and never sends your location.

strings.updates.eb7f9d58: Deer Creek Lake, Madison Lake, Knox Lake and Clear Fork Reservoir each get their own home page, map and ramps, lake rules, species notes, stocking and ice notes. Deer Creek shows a live lake level from the US Army Corps of Engineers.
strings.updates.eb837d30: Chips, toggles and lake tags keep their round pill shape, so the whole site uses just two.
strings.updates.ebf63bc1: The live lake level and tonight's bite now sit at the top of Home.
strings.updates.ed73a0a4: Once you pick a water, this phone or computer remembers it and opens that water's page next time. It never leaves your device. To choose another, use the lake picker on any water's page or add ?pick to the homepage address.
strings.updates.f3a26211: The privacy page now explains the new and returning visit tally: once a day the site notes only whether a phone has been here before, with no ID and nothing personal, and skips it when Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control is on.
strings.updates.f5e02579: Water adds a lake rules card, a water quality link to BeachGuard and Ohio EPA algae updates, and Buckeye Lake facts.
strings.updates.f70392dc: Languages: pick one in Display or from Language in the footer. Every piece of text now switches to the language you pick, rules included as draft translations that point to the official source. Choose from Español, 简体中文, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Français, 한국어, Português, हिन्दी, Русский, Kreyòl ayisyen, Deutsch, Polski, Italiano, 日本語, العربية, اردو and فارسی; Arabic, Urdu and Persian read right to left.
strings.updates.f7e21642: Every lake page now has a Quick facts block: motors and speed, ramps, normal pool and night rules, with the sources and the date they were checked.
